WATER BUILT UP INSIDE THE RELIEF VALVE STACK, DUE TO RAINY CONDITIONS MIXED WITH HIGH HORIZONTAL WINDS ALLOWING WATER TO BYPASS THE RAIN CAP, DUE TO A BROKEN HINGE WELD. THE WATER SLOWLY FROZE OVERTIME CAUSING THE RELIEF VALVE TO OPEN. THE DISCHARGE OF THE RELIEF VALVE ARE NOT INTENDED TO BE CAPTURED BY THE METHANE CENSOR, WHICH IS LOCATED BELOW THE RELIEF STACKS. THE SYSTEM OPERATED AS INTENDED FOLLOWING THE ACTIVATION OF THE SECONDARY RELIEF. -CUSTOMER WAS PUT BACK ON LINE AT1642 (CT) -CAUSE OF RELEASE IS GOING FROM UNKNOWN TO EQUIPMENT FAILURE. TWO WORKERS WERE BRIEFLY TRAPPED ON DANGLING SCAFFOLDING. FIRE PERSONNEL ARE STILL COMBING THE BUILDING FOR ANY ADDITIONAL PEOPLE.
